title: Scrape Any Website With AI Without Writing Code
description:
AI web scraping is making it much easier to extract useful data from websites without building traditional scrapers. ScrapeGraphAI lets you extract information such as prices, titles, reviews, news, and listings using plain English.

It’s an open-source tool that uses LLMs to understand web pages and return structured data, making website data extraction accessible even if you don't have much scraping experience.
